column3: Close to the Hebrew; “wonders” is rendered “wonderful things,” and “it has given victory to him” as “have gained the victory for Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make music” is rendered “sing praises.”
Close to the Hebrew; “harp” is rendered “lyre,” and “music” as “melody.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ram’s horn” is rendered “horn.”
Close to the Hebrew; “thunder” is rendered “roar.”
Close to the Hebrew; “together” is moved from the clapping to the singing (“sing together for joy”).
Close to the Hebrew; “uprightness” is rendered “equity.”
